last_invoice_date.name: last_invoice_date

mrr.name: mrr
mrr.comment: The amount of predictable revenue expected to be received on a monthly basis.

name.name: name

parent_account_id.name: parent_account_id

tax_exempt_expiration_date.name: tax_exempt_expiration_date

tax_exempt_status.name: tax_exempt_status

total_debit_memo_balance.name: total_debit_memo_balance

metadata.name: stg_zuora__amendment
metadata.comment: When a customer needs to make a change to a subscription, you make that change through an amendment. Common subscription changes include 'Changing the terms and conditions of a contract; add a product or update an existing product to a subscription; renew, cancel, suspend or resume a subscription.'

amendment_id.name: amendment_id
amendment_id.comment: The unique identifier of the amendment table.

auto_renew.name: auto_renew
auto_renew.comment: Determines whether the subscription is automatically renewed, or whether it expires at the end of the term and needs to be manually renewed.

booking_date.name: booking_date
booking_date.comment: The date when the amendment is signed.

code.name: code
code.comment: A unique alphanumeric string that identifies the amendment.

contract_effective_date.name: contract_effective_date
contract_effective_date.comment: The date when the amendment's changes become effective for billing purposes.

created_by_id.name: created_by_id
created_by_id.comment: Identifier of the user who created the amendment.

current_term.name: current_term
current_term.comment: The length of the period for the current subscription term.

current_term_period_type.name: current_term_period_type
current_term_period_type.comment: The period type for the current subscription term.

customer_acceptance_date.name: customer_acceptance_date
customer_acceptance_date.comment: The date when the customer accepts the amendment's changes to the subscription.

effective_date.name: effective_date
effective_date.comment: The date when the amendment's changes take effective. This field validates that the amendment's changes are within valid ranges of products and product rate plans.

new_rate_plan_id.name: new_rate_plan_id
new_rate_plan_id.comment: The id of the rate plan that was added to the subscription by this amendment.

removed_rate_plan_id.name: removed_rate_plan_id
removed_rate_plan_id.comment: The id of the rate plan that was removed from the subscription by this amendment.

renewal_setting.name: renewal_setting
renewal_setting.comment: Specifies whether a termed subscription will remain termed or change to evergreen when it is renewed.

renewal_term.name: renewal_term
renewal_term.comment: The term of renewal for the amended subscription.

renewal_term_period_type.name: renewal_term_period_type
renewal_term_period_type.comment: The period type for the subscription renewal term.

resume_date.name: resume_date
resume_date.comment: The date when the subscription resumption takes effect.

service_activation_date.name: service_activation_date
service_activation_date.comment: The date when service is activated.

specific_update_date.name: specific_update_date
specific_update_date.comment: The date when the UpdateProduct amendment takes effect.

subscription_id.name: subscription_id
subscription_id.comment: The id of the subscription that the amendment changes.

suspend_date.name: suspend_date
suspend_date.comment: The date when the subscription suspension takes effect.

term_start_date.name: term_start_date
term_start_date.comment: The date when the new terms and conditions take effect.

term_type.name: term_type
term_type.comment: Indicates if the subscription is TERMED (expiration date, must be manually renewed), EVERGREEN (doesn't have expiration date, must be manually ended).

updated_by_id.name: updated_by_id
updated_by_id.comment: Identifier of the user who last updated the amendment.

updated_date.name: updated_date
updated_date.comment: Last updated date for the amendment.

is_most_recent_record.name: is_most_recent_record
is_most_recent_record.comment: Is this the most recent record of the amendment.

metadata.name: stg_zuora__invoice
metadata.comment: An invoice represents a bill to a customer, providing information about customers' accounts for invoices, including dates, status, and amounts. It is created at the account level, and can include all of the charges for multiple subscriptions for an account.

invoice_id.name: invoice_id
invoice_id.comment: The unique identifier of the invoice table.

account_id.name: account_id
account_id.comment: The account identifier associated with the invoice.

adjustment_amount.name: adjustment_amount
adjustment_amount.comment: The amount of the invoice adjustments associated with the invoice.

amount.name: amount
amount.comment: The sum of all charges and taxes associated with the invoice.

amount_home_currency.name: amount_home_currency
amount_home_currency.comment: The total amount of the invoice in the home currency of the customer's billing account.

amount_without_tax.name: amount_without_tax
amount_without_tax.comment: The sum of all charges associated with the invoice. Taxes are excluded from this value.

amount_without_tax_home_currency.name: amount_without_tax_home_currency
amount_without_tax_home_currency.comment: The amount of the invoice that is not subject to tax, in the home currency of the customer's billing account.

auto_pay.name: auto_pay
auto_pay.comment: Whether invoices are automatically picked up for processing in the corresponding payment run.

balance.name: balance
balance.comment: The remaining balance of the invoice after all payments, adjustments, and refunds are applied.

bill_to_contact_id.name: bill_to_contact_id
bill_to_contact_id.comment: Person that you would like to bill or send the invoice to.

created_by_id.name: created_by_id
created_by_id.comment: Identifier of the user who created the invoice.

credit_balance_adjustment_amount.name: credit_balance_adjustment_amount
credit_balance_adjustment_amount.comment: The total amount of credit balance adjustments applied to the invoice.

credit_memo_amount.name: credit_memo_amount
credit_memo_amount.comment: The total amount of credit memos applied to the invoice.

default_payment_method_id.name: default_payment_method_id
default_payment_method_id.comment: Identifier of the default payment method for the account.

due_date.name: due_date
due_date.comment: The due date of the invoice.

exchange_rate.name: exchange_rate
exchange_rate.comment: The exchange rate used to convert the invoice amount into the customer's billing account currency.

exchange_rate_date.name: exchange_rate_date
exchange_rate_date.comment: The date the exchange rate was last updated.

home_currency.name: home_currency
home_currency.comment: Home currency the customer is billed in.

includes_one_time.name: includes_one_time
includes_one_time.comment: Specifies whether the invoice includes one-time charges.

includes_recurring.name: includes_recurring
includes_recurring.comment: Specifies whether the invoice includes recurring charges.

includes_usage.name: includes_usage
includes_usage.comment: Specifies whether the invoice includes usage charges.

invoice_date.name: invoice_date
invoice_date.comment: Specifies the date on which to generate the invoice.

invoice_number.name: invoice_number
invoice_number.comment: The unique identification number for the invoice.

last_email_sent_date.name: last_email_sent_date
last_email_sent_date.comment: The date when the invoice was last emailed.

parent_account_id.name: parent_account_id
parent_account_id.comment: The id of the parent account, if the invoice is associated with a parent-child account relationship.

payment_amount.name: payment_amount
payment_amount.comment: The amount of payments applied to the invoice.

payment_term.name: payment_term
payment_term.comment: The name of the payment term associated with the invoice.

posted_by.name: posted_by
posted_by.comment: The user ID of the person who moved the invoice to Posted status.

posted_date.name: posted_date
posted_date.comment: The date when the invoice was posted.

refund_amount.name: refund_amount
refund_amount.comment: Specifies the amount of a refund that was applied against an earlier payment on the invoice.

sold_to_contact_id.name: sold_to_contact_id
sold_to_contact_id.comment: Person that you have sold your product or services to; can be the same as the bill to contact.

source_id.name: source_id
source_id.comment: The identifier of the value in the source field.

source_type.name: source_type
source_type.comment: The type of the invoice source.

status.name: status
status.comment: The status of the invoice in the system. This status is not the status of the payment of the invoice, just the status of the invoice itself.

target_date.name: target_date
target_date.comment: The date the invoice is generated.

tax_status.comment: The status of tax calculation related to the invoice.

transaction_currency.comment: The currency in which the invoice is billed.

transferred_to_accounting.name: transferred_to_accounting
transferred_to_accounting.comment: Indicates whether the invoice has been transferred to the accounting system.

updated_by_id.name: updated_by_id
updated_by_id.comment: Identifier of the user who last updated the invoice.
